title: Inside velexis-deploy <sha>
caption: deploy/scripts/deploy.sh (installed as /usr/local/sbin/velexis-deploy). One flock on /run/velexis-deploy.lock; every failure before the switch leaves the running release untouched.

steps.label: verify_upload: SHA256SUMS lists exactly the files, all intact, no special files
RELEASE.json sha matches; Node major of the build == VM's node
check_env_files: every variable of deploy/env/*.env.example exists in /etc/velexis/*.env
steps.note: Missing names → 'env files lack variables…'; nothing changed.

steps.label: snapshot units, drop-in, Caddyfile, waf/, caddy build, maintenance page → /var/lib/velexis/system/<sha>/
stage Caddyfile.next / waf.next / caddy-velexis.next and caddy validate with caddy.env
install changed units + daemon-reload; install root scripts
systemd-run -p DynamicUser=yes -p EnvironmentFile=/etc/velexis/migrator.env node dist/cli/migrate.js platform | reference | tenants
apply files, record in schema_migrations (fan-out 4 at a time, abort > 10 % failures)
velexis-run ota node <rel>/ota-backend/dist/cli.js tenants:report-migrations --report migrate-<sha>.json
steps.note: Skipped on the first deploy (no running release).

steps.label: reference data load when the datasets' checksum changed (reference-loader.env)
restart workers → APIs → front ends, poll 127.0.0.1:<port>/health/ready ≤ 90 s each
unhealthy unit → rollback_to previous sha (snapshot units, switch back, restart), exit 1
activate: move staged files; reload, or restart when build or drop-in changed (record caddy-dropin.sha256)
append deploy-history; prune to 5 releases (never current or rollback target)
